10xteam-10xteam:ashbyhq:9b93337e-fd31-44.description: Updated: 07 July 2026 Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Investment Banking Analyst – AI Trainer – Freelance – 8–20 hrs/week – Remote (EU/UK) Freelance | 8–20 hrs/week | Remote (EU/UK) Are you an experienced Investment Banking Analyst interested in the rise of artificial intelligence? Join 10x Team as a Freelance Investment Banking Analyst – AI Trainer, leveraging your financial expertise to shape advanced AI models while enjoying the flexibility of remote, project-based work. About Us: 10x Team connects top freelance professionals with leading AI labs to accelerate innovation in artificial intelligence. We seek seasoned investment banking analysts, based in the EU or UK, to train AI systems focused on financial modeling, deal structuring, valuation, and transaction analysis. Key Responsibilities: - Review and refine AI-generated outputs related to investment banking, M&A, financial modeling, and capital markets - Evaluate the practicality and accuracy of AI recommendations for transaction execution, financial analysis, and deal assessment - Create and develop real-world scenarios and case studies from your investment banking experience - Generate scenario variations reflecting industry best practices, financial risk assessment, and compliance - Identify gaps or risks in AI-generated suggestions, and provide clear, actionable feedback - Guide AI systems to better understand, interpret, and apply investment banking concepts and methodologies About You: - Experienced Investment Banking Analyst with a background in M&A, capital markets, and financial modeling - Based in the EU or UK - Skilled in industry-standard financial modeling tools, transaction structuring, and market analysis - Analytical, detail-oriented, and able to provide structured, constructive feedback - Available for 8–20 hours per week, comfortable working remotely and asynchronously Why Join 10x Team? - Flexible, project-based freelance assignments – 100% remote - Directly influence how AI systems understand and support investment banking functions - Access professional development through our 10x Team AI Academy - Join a supportive network of independent experts with efficient onboarding How to Apply: After applying, you’ll receive an email detailing the steps to: - ⁠Complete a short written assessment - Participate in an AI-powered interview Important: Your application is only complete once you finish all steps via the email link. Please note: these AI Lab missions are not traditional job openings with fixed start dates. Project demand is highly dynamic and matching depends on your expertise, availability, and current AI Lab needs. Some experts are matched within days, while others may wait longer for a suitable project. Help shape the next generation of AI-driven investment banking—apply today! ----------------------------------------- NOTE At 10x, there are two types of opportunities: 1. Traditional freelance missions These are regular project-based opportunities where the listed mission is the actual project you may work on. 2. AI Lab roles For AI Lab roles, we scout, review, and approve profiles for access to future project opportunities. The missions listed for AI Lab roles are not traditional job openings. AI Lab work is often highly confidential as this exposes information of what an AI Lab is working on, and project requests are unpredictable. When an AI Lab request comes in, we often need to respond within 24 hours with suitable talent. Matching depends on the specific needs of each AI Lab project and your niche expertise. Once your profile is reviewed and approved, you may be matched to relevant AI Lab projects when suitable opportunities arise. This can happen within hours, but it may also take months, depending on the researchers at the AI labs and their project needs.

cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:6e.title: Heavy Duty Diesel Shop Manager
cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:6e.description: Our client is a family-owned and operated truck and trailer repair shop specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance, with a focus on the car hauling industry. They are fully equipped to handle all aspects of heavy-duty repair, offering top-tier diagnostic tools and a professional, supportive work environment. Our client is seeking a qualified Heavy-Duty Diesel Shop Manager to lead operations at a satellite repair facility specializing in dedicated fleet maintenance. This role requires a hands-on leader with the ability to diagnose required repairs and assist technicians in completing service orders while ensuring efficient shop operations. The facility consists of a two-bay shop that operates with a team of two technicians and a manager when fully staffed. The shop primarily services front-loaded cement mixers and tri-axle dump trucks, while also handling a wide range of heavy-duty repair work across the commercial truck industry.
responsibilities: Manage day-to-day operations of the satellite shop location and maintain a fully staffed team of two active technicians.
Provide hands-on leadership by diagnosing repair needs and assisting technicians with the completion of service orders when necessary.
Coordinate the daily shop schedule and workflow to ensure efficient service operations.
Monitor technician productivity and shop performance to meet company benchmarks for labor hours and billed service time.
Maintain quality control standards and ensure all work meets company and industry expectations.
Utilize OEM diagnostic platforms and industry-standard tools, including Cummins and PACCAR diagnostic systems, as well as Snap-on, JPRO, and other required diagnostic equipment.
Manage shop inventory levels and maintain organization of tools and equipment.
Order special-order parts as required to complete service orders and maintain workflow.
Communicate regularly with company leadership regarding shop performance, operational updates, and improvement opportunities.
qualifications: Valid Class A driver’s license (Preferred)
Previous experience in heavy-duty diesel repair, with the ability to diagnose and assist with complex mechanical and electrical issues.
Prior leadership or shop management experience preferred.
Strong knowledge of heavy-duty truck diagnostics, including experience with OEM diagnostic software such as Cummins and PACCAR systems.
Familiarity with industry diagnostic platforms such as Snap-on, JPRO, or equivalent tools.
Ability to manage workflow, technicians, and shop productivity in a fast-paced service environment.
Strong organizational and communication skills.
Valid driver’s license required.
Ability to consistently arrive on time and maintain a reliable work schedule.
Willingness to work a standard schedule of approximately 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM, with flexibility as operational needs require.
Must be able to pass random and incident-based drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policies.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Senior Director Corporate Strategy and Operations
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Company Overview Etiome is a privately held, early-stage biotechnology company advancing a proprietary Temporal Biodynamic platform to identify and discover novel drug targets and enabling biomarkers for chronic and progressive diseases—ensuring the right patient receives the right treatment at the right time. Role Overview The Senior Director, Corporate Strategy and Operations will serve as a strategic and operational partner to the CEO, translating company priorities into clear operating plans and driving cross-functional execution across Etiome. This role will act as a coordination point across the executive team and between Etiome and Flagship, with immediate focus on financing, out-licensing, and in-licensing activities. The right candidate will be highly organized, action oriented, and comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution levels in a fast-moving environment. Key Responsibilities Strategic Execution & Business Operations Partner with the CEO and executive team to translate corporate strategy, portfolio priorities, and platform objectives into operating plans, budgets, staffing plans, and measurable business objectives. Drive execution of the company's highest-priority strategic initiatives—including financing, out-licensing, and in-licensing—ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely delivery across functions. Track progress against strategic and operational priorities, providing clear reporting, metrics, and executive-level insights to support decision-making. Executive & Cross-Functional Leadership Serve as the operational hub across the executive team and between Etiome and Flagship, preparing leadership discussions, driving follow-through on decisions, resolving bottlenecks, and aligning priorities across R&D, Platform, Finance, Strategy, HR, and external partners. Build effective operating rhythms that improve planning, communication, execution, and organizational accountability. Corporate Development & Partnerships Support financing, business development, partnering, and licensing activities by coordinating cross-functional workstreams, developing analyses and presentation materials, and ensuring execution of key milestones. Bring structure, urgency, and operational discipline to strategic transactions and external collaborations. Executive Partnership Serve as a trusted thought partner to the CEO, bringing sound business judgment, analytical rigor, operational discipline, and a strong bias for action to the company's highest-priority initiatives. Anticipate organizational needs, proactively solve problems, and balance strategic thinking with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and execute. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree required; MBA or advanced business degree preferred. 7–12+ years of experience in strategy, business operations, corporate development, executive operations, management consulting, or related leadership roles within biotech, life sciences, or other innovation-driven industries. Demonstrated success translating strategy into operational plans and leading complex cross-functional initiatives from concept through execution. Experience partnering with senior executives and influencing stakeholders across all levels of an organization. Strong financial and business acumen, with experience supporting planning, budgeting, executive reporting, and strategic decision-making. Exceptional organizational, communication, and project leadership skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment. Hands-on operator with a bias for action who is equally comfortable developing strategy and executing against it. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting financing, business development, partnering, or in-licensing/out-licensing activities. Background in life sciences, biotechnology, or other complex scientific operating environments. Experience working directly with a CEO or executive leadership team in a high-growth company. gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:a4db5b46-.description: Sr. Principal Business Intelligence Analyst, Product Analytics - Engine by MoneyLion Location- New York Hybrid - 3 days in office About Gen Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries. Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We're always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate — leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results. When you're part of Gen, you'll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career — from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs. At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You'll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage. If this sounds like you, we'd love you to be part of Gen. How We Work Our hybrid work model (3 days in the New York office) gives us the face-to-face time to have creative conversations, meaningful meetings, make quick decisions, and build relationships. At the same time, it offers flexibility you need to focus and do your best work. jobgether-jobgether:lever:368b86a7-47cb-.title: Sr. Marketing Automation Specialist — Digital Experience
jobgether-jobgether:lever:368b86a7-47cb-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Marketing Automation Specialist — Digital Experience based in United States. This role offers the opportunity to shape how prospects move from digital engagement to meaningful marketing interactions and qualified opportunities. You will connect website experiences with HubSpot to create personalized, data-driven customer journeys across the marketing lifecycle. The position combines marketing automation, behavioral data, segmentation, personalization, and conversion optimization. You will design sophisticated nurture programs, identify next-best actions, and help turn digital behaviors into actionable engagement signals. As a subject-matter expert, you will also explore AI and emerging technologies to make marketing experiences more relevant, scalable, and effective. Working across Marketing, Web, Content, and Marketing Operations, you will serve as a critical operational bridge between digital touchpoints and downstream marketing processes. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced marketing automation professional who enjoys solving complex problems and improving measurable digital experiences Design and implement AI-enabled digital journeys across websites and HubSpot using workflows, forms, email, segmentation, personalization, and behavioral triggers. Map prospect and customer journeys and develop nurture programs that guide audiences from anonymous website visitors through identification, engagement, conversion, and qualification. Analyze prospect behaviors and identify next-best actions to coordinate relevant experiences across multiple marketing touchpoints. Own the operational connection between website experiences and HubSpot, ensuring engagement data is captured accurately and consistently. Establish and maintain standards for website-to-HubSpot tracking and data collection to support segmentation, automation, personalization, and lead nurturing. Serve as a subject-matter expert for HubSpot Marketing Hub automation, including emerging AI capabilities and opportunities to improve personalization, conversion, engagement, and marketing productivity. Partner with marketing stakeholders to define valuable digital engagement signals and determine which behaviors should contribute to lead scoring and qualification. Maintain quality assurance processes and comprehensive documentation for major automations, including triggers, dependencies, workflows, and business rules. Collaborate across Marketing, Web, Content, and Marketing Operations to connect digital experiences with broader prospect and lead-management journeys. Identify opportunities to improve automation performance, operational efficiency, and the consistency of global marketing programs. Requirements: 7+ years of professional experience in Marketing Operations, Marketing Automation, or a closely related discipline. At least 2 years of direct, hands-on experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub. Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing complex HubSpot workflows and nurture programs. Strong understanding of forms, landing pages, segmentation, personalization, behavioral triggers, and digital conversion strategies. Experience working with digital advertising platforms that drive traffic into digital marketing and conversion experiences. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to investigate issues, interpret behavioral data, and develop practical solutions. Excellent documentation and organizational skills, particularly for complex automation processes, dependencies, triggers, and business rules. Ability to collaborate effectively across marketing, web, content, and operations teams and communicate technical concepts to business stakeholders.
